title: [WIP] TCP: Introduce a Suspicious Packet analysis
description:
When a packet is outside of window either for its sequence or
acknowledge number, mark it as suspicious in order to help seeking
some type of anomalies or in-window attacks. Closes #8014

notes.body: This would work in that case, makes sense. I guess the one question is whether there are many TCP connections that stay open for 2 GiB of data transfer, at which point it would start reporting all packets as suspicious due to wraparound. I think that's probably fairly rare, and likely creates other issues. (It's more common across multiple connections, where it definitely can play havoc with reassembly in captures with packet loss, or with protocols with smaller sequence number domains than TCP.)
for now, I won't go further and I am closing this. The real subject (classification of suspicious packets) is too broad for a single MR and should be discussed.
